notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/d0af9d626e89069b40d7a4487ad439e094933850.png[/img]

[h1]Highlights:[/h1]
[list]
[*]5 new maps + map reworks
[*]Surf changes
[*]Leaderboard reset
[*]New netcode
[*]New anti-cheat
[*]New floor detection
[*]Startup optimizations
[*]Replays record pre-run
[*]New end-of-game voting
[*]Close Characters fade out
[*]Map Pools (supporter only)
[/list]

[b]For version 1.1's release the Supporter Bundle is 25% off for the weekend[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469980/SurfsUp__Supporter_Bundle/

[h1]New Maps[/h1]
[list]
[*]SnowGlobe by Spanky (1 Star)
[*]Spkneon by Spanky (2 Star)
[*]Crinkle by conkin (3 Star)
[*]Fragmented by soh (4 Star)
[*]Stone by soh (5 Star)
[/list]

[h1]Surf Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Max surf speed reduced from 12.192 -> 8.128
[*]Max speed at start reduced from 466 -> 350
[*]Ground acceleration reduced from 10 -> 5
[*]Max walk speed in spawn set to 320
These changes were made to be more in-line with other Source engine surf games. I plan to experiment with surf changes each "season" and plan to reset leaderboards to accommodate changes.
[/list]

[h1]Leaderboards Reset[/h1]

With the changes to speed the old records are now unachiveable. The leaderboards have been 'soft-reset,' the old scores still remain in the backend and will be featured on the website in the future.

[h1]New Netcode[/h1]

Thanks to the changes made to the SteamMultiplayerPeer, we've implemented entirely new net code! Hopefully this should make for more stable and consistent network connections, with the potential for larger lobbies

[h1]New Anti-cheat[/h1]

Without going into [i]too much[/i] detail, the game now checks integrity and validates multiple variables during game play. There is potential for false flags, if you get falsely kicked to main menu with an integrity error please report it to the [url=https://discord.gg/95XmYfPnwV]Discord server[/url]

[h1]Replays record pre-start[/h1]

Replays now record the first 3 seconds before a run begins, but also immediately start when a run begins so you can still race a ghost from timed tick zero.

[h1]New Floor Detection[/h1]

The game now detects when the surfer is on a floor differently. Instead of relying on Godot's [i]is_on_floor[/i] and a 3-strike system, we now use a 5 raycast system with instant resets. This allows players to not be reset when riding the spine of a ramp, and will hopefully be more reliable when colliding with certain angles and floors.

[h1]Startup Optimizations[/h1]

The game now displays a "Loading Surfsup" screen on boot. Player models now load asynchronously instead of during boot.

[h1]HUD rewritten[/h1]

The game's HUD has been entirely refactored and separated from the surfer. This allows us to start accessing, hiding, and [i](in the future)[/i] moving and sizing individual HUD elements.

[h1]Map Pools (supporter only)[/h1]

A new feature added for supporters is "Map Pools." When hosting a game you can now select [i]which maps[/i] you want in your rotation.

[h2]New Host Game UI[/h2]

With the new map pools there's a new host game UI for selecting maps.

[h2]Lobby & Map settings now save and load[/h2]

Previously selected map(s) and lobby settings now save and load locally.

[h2]Map Authors added[/h2]

The map authors have been added to the level select and player menu (TAB)

[h1]Character Distance Fade[/h1]

Characters now fade when close to the camera and cull their back face so you no longer see 'inside' of players' models and models close to the camera will dither away

[h1]New end-game map vote[/h1]

The map end-game voting now shows 4 options for votes and the count of votes by all players per map

[h1]New Supporter DLC Banner[/h1]

Non-supporters will see a banner promoting the Supporter DLC on the main menu

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*][i]hide_chat[/i] console command
[*]Paint / Clear paint now bindable
[*]Prev / Next saveloc defaults to [i], / .[/i] now
[*]Max checkpoints have been increased to 50
[*]Lobby chat now persists between map changes
[*]0.000 second times now show as DNF (did not finish)
[/list]

[h1]Map Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ascension: Backwards skip blocked
[*]Stormy: Now symmetrical
[*]Strafe Course: Now has a ceiling
[*]Glowhop: Walls extended to edge
[*]Christmas: Sleigh collision removed
[*]Nebula: Reworked and boxed in
[*]Kitsune: Savelocs re-enabling timer fixed
[*]Summit: Out of bound skip fixed
[*]Lavahop: End zone platform position fixed to be inline with the zone
[*]Fix Settings Panel on Boreas
[*]Fix Settings Panel on Mesa
[*]Optimized Prism
[*]Skip Blocks on Mesa Revo
[*]Fiellu: Cleaned Up Ramps, Light, Bake VoxelGI, and add Settings Panel.
[/list]

notes.title: Racing Fest, New Maps, and More!
notes.content:
[h1]Racing Fest[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/73ae15d5d2dade58066177ed517cfa1fbdd978f2.png[/img]
Racing Fest features games that focus on proving who is the fastest, most skilled, or most competitive racer. While the event traditionally includes car racing games, SurfsUp is being included! This is my first time participating in a Steam festival and I am [b]extremely[/b] excited.

[h1]Map Settings[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/2cfc18c01478189fdf7d05f4b339edf6b768aaae.png[/img]
With the new visual updates to maps, [b]Nerdiful[/b] has added in a 'settings remote' at spawn. These are [i]local only[/i] options allowing you to change the visuals of a map, either to change up the lighting and style, or adjust performance. You need to activate the buttons using the new [i]USE[/i] key, which is bound to [b]E[/b] by default (can be rebound in settings)

[h2]Example:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/45b1a7226751ee4d3218d65ce73671ad5f9593f6.gif[/img]

[h1]New Mesa[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/ea2d7a1512ec6213a79ff88c1f9952e3c47c336a.png[/img]
OG Mesa received a massive overhaul, rebuilding collisions and getting a new visual pass thanks to [b]Nerdiful.[/b]

[h1]Mesa Revo[/h1]
Mesa revo also has a pass done on the collision shapes for the ramps, removing ramp bugs.

[h1]New Community Map: Potato[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/9d2a77670ccca7bab83e0338158c3419c5d80b37.png[/img]
By [b]Hersch[/b], a new 2-star city map where you surf around large skyscraper buildings

[h1]New Community Map: Wagon[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/bf923d9bba17dbe99429806ba3a15897cc85a20c.png[/img]
By [b]DeniedWorks[/b], a new 4-star map with surf ramps over a mountainous forest

[h1]New Community Map: Grind[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/72567205440f958e930db5ad5e59977f969b9ab2.png[/img]
By [b]Jago the Artist[/b], Grind is a unique 2-star map featuring scripted sound effects to simulate riding a skateboard (You can turn down SFX audio to lower the volume)

[h1]New Community Map: Vine[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/2a7d65b5de6a551e37b68c5af590587f09683c47.png[/img]
Vine is a new 1-star map created by [b]Spanky[/b] aimed to help new players learn to gain speed, manage, and maintain it.

[h1]New Community Map: Edge[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/dfc264e6d1b78dbc1b9b2401c05b97e82d636f51.png[/img]
Created by [b]soh[/b], Edge is a new 4-star map with unique routing and implementation.

[h1]New Community Map: Revolve[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/ad3c24b3c549ce68d4aeffdf6b558ebf8a6cb882.png[/img]
Revolve is a new 5-star map created by [b]soh[/b]

[h1]Quality of Life / Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bugged times have been removed from the leaderboard
[*][b]Every map[/b] has had their finish line rezoned due to SDK Update and technical debt
[*]Boreas, Mesa, and Grass have a map settings menu
[*]Boreas now kills you when entering the water at the end
[*]Boreas: Snow particles now collide with spawn zone
[*]Item drop rate has been reduced to 1 item / day
[*]New 'use' interact button (defaults to E)
[*]Checkpoint exploit fixed
[*]No clip exploit fixed
[*]SDK / Custom Maps now have zone support for custom Start/Finish zones and kill boxes
[*]Main Menu's video preview (3D Scene) has been optimized for better performance
[*]Debug Menu (HOME key) has been re-enabled with FPS debug
[*]Paint (P) now ignores players and properly faces decals
[*]Ghost color is now trail color (to help colorblind players)
[*]Ghosts now play surf animation when moving
[*]Respawning in no-clip now removes no-clip
[*]Field of View setting now loads custom values on game launch
[/list]

[h1]SDK Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]New exporting method - Export Button now recursively scans and packages all dependencies in the scene
[*]Textures updated with new compressed textures from release
[*]Finish/Landing platforms updated with the latest ones by Nerdiful from release
[*]Added base organization similar to main project
[/list]

notes.title: New Boreas, Community Maps, and Extend
notes.content:
[h1]Re-ported Map: Boreas[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/c14e9c2f2f0d6b512cddd7dac545dc8d0b9839ef.png[/img]
[b]Nerdiful[/b] re-ported Boreas, scaled it down to be closer to the original map, added snow that follows the player until they enter the cave, did lighting, particles, and custom environmental scripts also creating a custom collision shape to fix ramp bugs. We will be doing this process across all the current and future ported maps in the game.

[h1]New Community Bhop Map: Lavahop[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/fa252147e1e7eb8605ba29158813014a203e59b5.png[/img]
Created by community member [b]Angelina[/b] Lavahop is a new Bhop map featuring a unique lava shader.

[h1]New Community Map: Grass[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/abe6f98fc8cbd0f3b61940fe71fa42595957b8d0.png[/img]
Created by community member [b]The_5torm[/b] Grass is a 2-Star map with a unique grass shader and Voxel Global Illumination

[h1]New Community Map: Spky[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/d6bdc1c9745e916707e6237344f87357168a81bb.png[/img]
Created by community member [b]Spanky[/b] Spky is a 2-Star map featuring a unique crystal layout with large long ramps and hidden pumpkins. Can you find all 3?

[h1]New Community Map: YardTime[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/9d715a8b26a725f2cd4a1c63c8cf44643a7a990a.png[/img]
Created by community member [b]XDLMAO[/b] YardTime is a prison break themed 3-star map.

All community maps have songs created by [b]prodtwon[/b]
[b]Grass:[/b] twon - goodbye
[b]Spky:[/b] Pietsbeats x Prodbytwon - why did you
[b]Lavahop:[/b] twon - breathe
[b]Yardtime:[/b] twon + blazyx - good karma

[list]
[*][b]Private lobbies are now available to all players[/b]
[*][b]Sentry.io[/b] crash logging has been added to the game
[*]Windows rendering device switched back to [b]Vulkan[/b] instead of [b]DX12[/b]
[list]
[*]If you are AMD on Windows and see scan lines while playinguse the launch option [i]--rendering-driver d3d12[/i] to switch back to DX12
[/list]
[*]You can now [b]!extend[/b] in chat to extend the map timer for 5m
[*]Mouse sensitivity now has a max limit
[*]Strafe course maze has been fixed
[list]
[*]Strafe course scores have been reset
[/list]
[*]F4 Paint (P) [i]should[/i] have proper normals
[*]You can now clear paint with the O button
[*][b]Player now noclips[/b] when pressing F4, this will disable the timer until you respawn, you can F4 again to 'drop in' anywhere on a ramp
[*]Summit Bhop loading screen fix
[*]Kitsune Collisions fixed
[*]Tutorial end zone collisions fixed
[*]Fixed an issue where you could break speed limit by leaving spawn, re-entering, and setting a checkpoint
[*]Fixed an issue where scores failed to upload
[*]" joined" will now always show the player's Steam name
[*]Options menu defaults to 'Game' options again
[*]Player interpolation rewritten
[*]Spectator cam interpolation rewritten
[*]Field of View (FOV) now stays between level changes
[/list]

James from Unaccessible is now always shows but locked unless you own the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419670/Unaccessible/

notes.title: SurfsUp is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]SurfsUp has released on Steam[/h1]
Thanks to all the players who participated in the play test, private beta, and Next Fest demo, and pre-release phases of development. The game has now launched free-to-play for all on Steam, and the game [b]would not be what it is without all of you[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454830/SurfsUp/

[h2]The Supporter Bundle DLC is now available[/h2]
Support the future development of SurfsUp by purchasing the Supporter Bundle DLC. It enables you to host custom lobbies, comes with the Counter-Terrorist and Sitting Clapping cosmetics, and unlocks access to all maps.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469980/

[h1]New Tutorial:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/fdcb825e874f0d31105c09c64b82055b655f1df0.png[/img]
Designed by community member [b]Angelina[/b], the new tutorial is a "0-star" map meant to help new players understand the basics. The new tutorial features [b]animated info-graphs[/b] at each stage to help new players understand how to play. To ease new players into the game without the pressure of a timer, you cannot see your run timer on Tutorial until you have a clear on the map.

[h1]New Map: Strafe Course[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/d5c7ea53af4b563497c14b4da344b8c303217dc6.png[/img]
Created by community member [b]500 Ping[/b] Strafe Course is a unique map without gravity to help teach players how to air-strafe. This map features 5 keys spread across a mini-golf course for you to collect to reach the final hole.

[h1]Map rework: Nerdiful[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/e4443853cc4fe39622b13bcc1ab73f08349bd705.png[/img]
Created by [b]Nerdiful[/b], the ramps and layout have been redesigned and the level has been lit and textured.

[h1]Map Rework: Christmas[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/57f5eb0688da6e2d2deb49f81c47bb645c04ffae.png[/img]
The Christmas map has been redesigned and reworked, players now start inside of a gift-wrapped present and have to strafe around holiday ornaments.

[h1]New Map: Dark Bhop[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/b47c6800203792e512953294b44684103326a58c.png[/img]
Designed by community member [b]Angelina[/b], Dark Bhop is a new map for the bhop game mode with a flat 'maze' to help people learn air-strafing and have an easier time understanding how to bhop.

[h1]New Map: Dunes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/ce826915a4606d48cf7d2fc381763fd3c60d6656.png[/img]
Designed by community member [b]Angelina[/b], Dune is a 1-Star trick surf map to teach players mid-run bhops and spins

[h1]New Ported Map: Kitsune[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/15ef4f6f0c1c3f25b9f11c24e56509806ee32cd3.png[/img]
Kitsune by Amoreloba has been ported and added to the permanent map pool. It also adds [b]staged map support to SurfsUp![/b] [b]HUGE[/b] thanks to Nerdiful for putting in [b]a ton[/b] of work on the port.

[h1]New Ported Map: OG Mesa[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/b0910ddb3b9924de7fb8b9f31e65ed7bcea5bf35.png[/img]
Original Mesa by Amoreloba has been ported and added to the permanent map pool.

[h1]New Bonus: Kvas B4[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/13fe684bdf331891bd3d0dcc75a55710b768d34e.png[/img]
KVAS Bonus 4 has been added to the bonus map pool.

[h1]New Community Maps: Space Zero & Amenhotep[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/9381a2e27ebe320d7915a5fd4d121e6a0eada91e.png[/img]
Created by community member [b]GOOGOOO GAGA MENTALITY[/b] using the [url=https://bearlikelion.github.io/SurfsUpSDK/]SurfsUp SDK Project[/url], [b]SpaceZero[/b] is a 2-star surf map with rotating planets, and [b]Amenhotep[/b] is a new bhop map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/7919ddc5fa1db3cdc1c5bc7ac2ca323746d94cf5.png[/img]

[h1]Downloadable Replays[/h1]

[i]Race your friends ghosts or watch the world record replay[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/d95cd96dd1a8f20c7995c8cf2abd60cb41fb3b49.png[/img]
The replay for every run on the leaderboard is now uploaded to Steam! You can use the ESC menu to download and race against or watch other player's replays. Replays now also use a [i]cat-mull rom algorithm[/i] for smooth and accurate playback.

[h1]Pre-hop Limit[/h1]

[b]Speed limit added on start zone exit:[/b] Player movement speed is now capped at 466/units when leaving the start zone, [i]ensuring competitive fairness[/i].

[h1]Checkpoint (Saveloc) Rework[/h1]
[list]
[*]F1 no longer clears checkpoints
[*]F2 now clears all checkpoints
[*]Hitting the floor or killbox will reset you to spawn
[*]Reset (R) will reset to latest checkpoint
[*]Holding Reset will freeze the player in the air with a locked camera
[/list]

[h1]Ranked Groups[/h1]

Your score now sorts you into groups based on map rank. Groups are shown on the player menu (TAB) once you have a clear on a map. Your rank is also posted to the map clears chat window.
[list]
[*]Legend - Top 1%
[*]Grand master - Top 10%
[*]Master - Top 25%
[*]Intermediate - Top 50%
[*]Novice - Bottom 50%
[/list]

[h1]Website Leaderboard & Twitch Integration[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/2db7f7b2bbf00d1880d4347caef5313b4f68cca0.png[/img]
You can now view and share your leaderboards at https://surfsup.website, additionally if you live stream on Twitch under the category SurfsUp you'll be featured on the home page and posted to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/95XmYfPnwV]Discord server[/url]!

[h1]New Start/Finish Platforms[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/e8dddac53bd8bb0585e2ae64cdf9b7fdb0cc286e.gif[/img]
Designed and modeled by [b]Nerdiful[/b], the start and finish platforms have new geometry, accurate zoning, and [i]fancy[/i] RGB lighting.

[h1]Maps:[/h1]

[b]All Maps:[/b] Performance & optimization pass, re-organized and re-starred the maps to be more accurate based on number of completions from Next Fest demo.
[b]Christmas:[/b] Moved to 2-star map
[b]Mesa[/b] renamed to [b]Mesa Revo[/b]
[b]Rainbow:[/b] Ramp transparency / texture changed
[b]Prism:[/b] Ramp transparency changed
[b]Starry:[/b] New "moon" texture for ramps
[b]Summit:[/b] Start zone rezoned
[b]Utopia:[/b] Start zone rezoned
[b]SoulSearch:[/b] Added kill floor on first jump, new labels and arrow directions to show routes.

[h2]New Music:[/h2]

[i]Whimsical Beats released an album for the game titled '[b]Music for Surfing[/b]', check it out on bandcamp:[/i] https://whimsicalbeats.bandcamp.com/album/music-for-surfing
[b]Beginner:[/b] Coastal Calm by Whimsical Beats
[b]Boreas:[/b] Subset Drive by Whimsical Beats
[b]Castle Jump:[/b] Quiet Breath by Whimsical Beats
[b]Dark BHop:[/b] Cloud Gazing by Whimsical Beats
[b]Dunes:[/b] Whirlwind Whisper by Whimsical Beats
[b]Fiellu:[/b] Building Blocks by Whimsical Beats
[b]KvasB4:[/b] Inertia by Whimsical Beats
[b]Mesa:[/b] Crystals and Caverns by Whimsical Beats
[b]Nerdiful:[/b] Midnight Moves by Whimsical Beats
[b]River Gap:[/b] Water Wonderland by Whimsical Beats
[b]Starry:[/b] Star Eyed by UMOS8
[b]Stormy:[/b] Circuit Breaker by Whimsical Beats
[b]Sunset:[/b] Lost in Motion by Whimsical Beats
[b]Tutorial:[/b] Tutorial by DeathbyAlbatross
[b]Utopia:[/b] Meditation by Whimsical Beats

[h1]Player Muting[/h1]

You can now mute players on the player menu (TAB). Muting a player stops all voice and text chat from being received from that players. Muted players persist between lobbies but [i]currently[/i] reset when the game closes.

[h1]UI[/h1]

[b]UI Elements are now networked and can be viewed by spectators.[/b]
[list]
[*]When spectating another player, you will now see [b]their[/b] speed, syncbar, timer, inputs, and if the timer is disabled
[*]The amount of players spectating is shown on screen next to an eye icon
[*]Change map host select drop down is now sorted by map category
[*]New input key icons which now include duck and jump
[*]Clear times are now split into their own chat box
[*]A player's first clear of a map will now be shown
[*]Clears always show in clear box, and display +/- times from personal best
[*]Host crown has been replaced with a 'host border'
[*]Added Spectate / Mute / Steam Profile action buttons to player menu (TAB)
[*]Host name is now yellow

notes.title: v0.9.641 Patch Notes - F2P & New Zoning
notes.content:
[h1]Surfsup.website[/h1]

I have registered a domain for the game, https://surfsup.website
In the future, this will be a website featuring leaderboards, map rotation, user profiles, and more. I am also [b]interested in working on this with the community[/b] so if you would like to help, please make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/95XmYfPnwV]SurfsUp Discord Server.[/url]

[h1]Free-to-Play Model[/h1]

With NextFest and the [b]v1.0 demo[/b] coming up, we have implemented the free-to-play model into SurfsUp. There are [b]13 available maps per day[/b] rotating [b]every 24 hours.[/b] The [b]7 ported maps will always be included[/b] in the available maps. You can now only select cosmetics that are available in your Steam inventory. [b]Cosmetics will reset back to default[/b] when loading the patch. A timer now shows on the main menu letting you know when maps will rotate. [b]All maps become available[/b] when you purchase the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469980/SurfsUp__Supporter_Bundle/]supporter bundle[/url][/b]. 

I am looking for feedback on this model, so please let me know what you think on the Discord server!

[h1]Zoning Reworked[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/b1fb5356860148c2788223e3059f1832d4b11cd7.png[/img]
After discussion with some members of the community, we have [b]rezoned every map in the game.[/b]

Zones are now a "box collider" where the timer begins as soon as you exit the area. Previously the starting line was a horizontal world boundary, this allowed players to pre-hop further into the map and start a few seconds ahead of others. This change makes the competition [i][b]fair for all[/b][/i] now having the same starting location for every player.

Zones are outlined with a mesh wire-frame, Green for start zones, red for end zones, and blue or grey to represent invisible walls in the maps.

'Show Zones' is now enabled by default, but can be disabled in Game Settings or using the console command [code]showzones false[/code]

Due to the zoning changes, [b]all leaderboards have been reset[/b]

[h1]New Map: AirControl[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/910035b7bde8d534d72580bf03a5f130773d80a8.png[/img]
AirControl is a new ported 1-star map, it has been re-lit and re-textured for SurfsUp and is a long and forgiving map with multiple ramps aimed towards beginners.

[h1]New Map: Forest[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/f29bdc62ae15fa5bfbc937dfed890d10d534457b.png[/img]
Forest is a new map by community member [b]Raq[/b], it is a 3-star map with multiple routes to a single end-zone.

[h1]New Community Map: SoulSearch[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/7c801b6fdb38b8ae0582d067fa85a4172b891dd1.png[/img]
SoulSearch is a new 4-star map created by community member [b]500 Ping[/b] using the [url=https://bearlikelion.github.io/SurfsUpSDK/]SurfsUp SDK[/url] Project! It features multiple routes with various paths, each path being quicker than the last.

[h1]Crouching recoded[/h1]

[i]Crouching before:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/ecb57b637fa4dd03f448738294b65bb75f58368b.gif[/img]
There have been some issues with the character's crouching. Previously, it had a 0.4s delay for "is_ducking" to the "ducked" state. The entire code for crouching has been rewritten to now be instant and to keep the same collision shape on the character instead of replacing it with a new one.

[i]Crouching after:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/6b378292d880142d6787800cd46dc9b9309d0155.gif[/img]

[h1]New Music[/h1]

[b]Raqqit[/b]: Down the Rabbit Hole by spineywoodchuck
[b]Ruins[/b]: Explore the Ruins by spineywoodchuck

[h1]Dev Console[/h1]

New console command [i]disconnect[/i] to leave a lobby
New console alias [i]load[/i] for [i]map[/i] to load custom maps
New console alias [i]qqq[/i] for [i]quit[/i] and [i]exit[/i]
Opening console enables [i]is_typing[/i] so character no longer moves when typing in console
Console will capture mouse again when closing in-game

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Surfer: Model, Animation, Player Color, and Trail color now synchronize on the network
[*]Option menu defaults to [i]Game Options[/i] again
[*]Fixed changing a player's color changing [i]all player's[/i] color
[*]If jump is bound to mouse scroll you will no longer jump when scrolling elements in the UI
[*]Moving the mouse while holding down a mouse button while spectating will no longer changes who you are spectating every frame
[*]Leaving spectator mode no longer freezes the player in the [i]is_typing[/i] state
[*]Various netcode optimizations
[*]Starting lines removed from all levels
[*]Map Voting RPC moved out of the UI Scripts and into the NetCode
[*]Various textures have been replaced in the game that referenced licensed / adult themes
[*]Stretch Mode now properly sets the saved setting on load
[*]Fullscreen now properly sets the saved setting on load
[*]Game should now properly launch in full screen on first launch
[/list]

As a reminder, [b]the beta will be ending on May 18th 2025.[/b] We will be revoking [i]all beta keys[/i] and transitioning to the v1.0 demo which will be releasing [b]May 30th[/b] on Steam.

Thank you all for playing and providing feedback.
-Mark
